name: PlayAdapt
description: Theme-adaptive player enhancement engine for Jellyfin official client with zero disk footprint.
overview: PlayAdapt dynamically inspects any active Jellyfin theme, anchoring custom player features seamlessly into place with native styling, geometry, and glassmorphism.

versions.changelog: Initial Release: Theme-Adaptive Player Engine with real-time theme inspection, spatial layout resolver, native component factory, admin configuration dashboard, and showcase aspects (playback speed, clean frame screenshot, stream stats HUD, and dialogue audio boost).
